actionRider.note: adds three options: Proliferate (expand an existing element), Regulate (air, fire, metal or water — change its temperature) and Sculpt (earth, metal or wood — reshape it into a small crude object).

why: Printed: "Add the following options to Base Kinesis." WG encodes this as injectText {type:'feat', id:21758 (Base Kinesis), text:'…Proliferate…Regulate…Sculpt…'} — its only operation. We encoded NOTHING (actionCost:passive alone), so the three options existed only inside this feat's own description and never reached the Base Kinesis row where a player performs it. modifiesGrant.actionRider is our field for exactly this (Principle C / RECORD_MARKERS on:'action'). Verified end to end: build.ts:4109 turns it into grantMarkers, recordMarkersFor(c, db, 'action', 'base-kinesis') returns it, and MainTab.tsx:589 keys markers off actionId(a.name) = 'base-kinesis'; classFeatures/base-kinesis carries actionCost {actions:2} so it IS an action row. Confirmed on BOTH routes — the kineticist (owns classFeatures/base-kinesis) and the archetype (took feats/base-kinesis) — since the `from` gate is ownedIds over feats + class features. Note deliberately does not open with the feat's own name (all three renderers prefix it).

Printed: "Your roots in the world grant you the plant trait." WG's first operation is giveTrait traitId:1654 (plant). We encoded nothing: the record carries traits ['plant','yaksha'] but creatureTraitsOf (derive.ts:2401) reads a heritage's grantsCreatureTraits ONLY — a heritage's own `traits` array is never read — and the ancestry half comes from ancestries.yaksha.traits, which is ['spirit','yaksha']. Measured before/after on a built yaksha: BEFORE ['spirit','yaksha'], AFTER ['spirit','yaksha','plant (granted / Respite of Loam and Leaf)'] on the Details tab. Same shape the sibling heritage tidepool-dragonet already uses (traits ['amphibious'] AND grantsCreatureTraits ['amphibious']). The cantrip half is untouched: our effectChoices picker already grants an at-will primal innate cantrip, matching their `select from:SPELL` filtered to Cantrip+Primal, and the option list stays ours.
